subject: I still have 20 events to do.
author: SUFFUR
body:
But the online is getting better, just need somethings sorted, when we get the update and DLC, though most updates seem to be happening as they get addressed, I think?

Just need a faster Watson Roadster, and not a speed version, though that could be interesting?

 

But While taking breaks from Paradsie, have had a go at the XNA games, really great stuff there, and FrontLines, which is cool, but a bit laggy at the mo and needs driving controls like the Burnout games, they do make it complictaed when you need to use both thumbsticks to drive a car? Imagine Burnout like that?? I think they are trying to make them drive like the Warthog from Halo, but it seems way off.

Also the first and last plane i flew in that game, I crashed into the first building on the runway, I need to learn more controls, a universal type of control set up is needed or a control customiser is need, with in the Dash of the 360, so i don't have to keep going into my menu to tweak my control set up every ten minutes, to find something that works.

PS It was Mothers Day yesterday, for those of you that may have forgot? I know my day of Motherly celabration did not go as planed but it was nice to talk to her in the end.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
